host: WSL2 Arch (AMD R7 5800HS 3.19 GHz, 2 vCPU, 7.6 GB)
method: median of 3 runs; C2 = full-process wall (timer spawns a process); C3 = in-process scan wall (scan is called in-process by the app)

mv-timemachine --check-due.note: Secret (libsecret) retained in timer mode for passphrase lookup

notes: C2: lazy Gtk import in timer one-shots; Gtk import (~150-400 ms) eliminated from the --check-* path.
C3: mtime+size+count-keyed scan-result cache; warm hit skips all file reads. Cold miss carries a one-time fingerprint+cache-write overhead per library change.

C3 cold-miss overhead is the price of invalidation (walk+stat fingerprint) + JSON cache write; warm scan is the common case (2nd+ app open) and is 7.7x (music) / 2.1x (photos) faster than the pre-cache full scan.
All host numbers are WSL2/5800HS-relative deltas, NOT MacBook predictions (honesty contract).
